senses.sense_definition: Iets aan iemand geven door het in de richting van die persoon te houden of uit te steken.

examples.text: De ober <w>reikte</w> de menukaart aan de gasten <w>aan</w>.

target_lang_translations.it: Il cameriere ha <w>porso</w> il menù agli ospiti.
target_lang_translations.en: The waiter <w>handed</w> the menu to the guests.

examples.text: Zou je mij het zout even kunnen <w>aanreiken</w>?

target_lang_definitions.it: Dare qualcosa a qualcuno tenendolo verso di lui o porgendolo.
target_lang_definitions.en: To give something to someone by holding it out towards them or passing it to them.

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: Offrire o dare qualcosa a qualcuno tendendo la mano.
Dare un oggetto a qualcuno che si trova vicino.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To give or pass something to someone, often by reaching out.
To give an object to someone who is nearby.

senses.sense_definition: Iets aan iemand geven waarbij men zich moet uitrekken of over iets heen moet buigen.

examples.text: Hij moest ver over de balie buigen om het formulier aan het kind <w>aan</w> te <w>reiken</w>.

target_lang_translations.it: Ha dovuto sporgersi molto oltre il bancone per <w>allungare</w> il modulo al bambino.
target_lang_translations.en: He had to lean far over the counter to <w>hand</w> the form to the child.

examples.text: Ze <w>reikte</w> hem het zakdoekje <w>aan</w> terwijl ze haar tranen wegveegde.

target_lang_translations.it: Gli ha <w>teso</w> il fazzoletto mentre si asciugava le lacrime.
target_lang_translations.en: She <w>reached</w> him the tissue while wiping away her tears.

target_lang_definitions.it: Dare qualcosa a qualcuno allungandosi o sporgendosi verso di lui.
target_lang_definitions.en: To give something to someone by stretching or leaning towards them.

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: Allungare la mano o il braccio per dare qualcosa.
Sporgersi per consegnare un oggetto a qualcuno.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To stretch out one's arm or body to give or get something.
To deliver something to someone, often requiring an effort to reach.
